entities.summary: Złoczew is a town in Sieradz County, Łódź Voivodeship, in central Poland, with 3,340 inhabitants (2020). It is located in the historic Sieradz Land, 23 kilometres south of Sieradz and 23 kilometres north of Wieluń.
